elements.text: Modular, service-based architecture is built to scale with continued growth; loose coupling improves extensibility while cohesive APIs enhance maintainability

elements.text: The platform is structured as a set of independent services, each supported by a dedicated database and capable of scaling independently. The modular design enables extensibility through loose coupling, while cohesive API boundaries and cloud-native deployment support maintainability, resilience, and production scalability

Mostly PaaS (EKS, RDS)
Some IaaS (EC2 - Linux)

Multiple availability zones 
Single production region (US-East-1)
Single development region (US-West-1)
App: no demand-based auto-scaling
Data replication to EU-West-1, annual tabletop exercises
